limits: Only immutable NSGT kernel coefficients and grid data are shared through Arc. Every clone retains independent ring, FFT buffer, scratch, smoothing and output. Construction-time kernel ownership changes; sample arithmetic, model, routing, policy and evaluation defaults do not.

The measured128-clone population requests6,302,720 bytes after versus124,754,944 before for each tested power mode at48k/2048FFT/hop512/grid55..8000Hz/96bins per octave. This excludes original construction and the already allocated container, and is not process RSS or whole-system memory acceptance.

Clone divergence/reset after populated history matches independently constructed streams bit-for-bit. Scratch reuse remains allocation-free under its existing feature-enabled test. The ordinary full suite includes the clone independence test; allocation-count tests run explicitly with profile-alloc.

Six-case audio and semantic comparisons remove timing and canonicalize emission order. Both buses have756 common observations in each comparison. All paired cost results are retained, including regressions.

Resource values are whole-run wall times and bounded histogram quantile intervals. Offline whole-hop timing includes deterministic worker completion waits; this is not CPU time, live-device acceptance, full-duration or full-eight-prototype preflight.
Physical prototype transfer, non-energy consequences, full conditional default and remaining normal integrations are incomplete. I10 remains active; I9 held; I11 disabled.
